description:
Metadata-only submission for ``POST /v1/batches``.

Tier 2 batch upload is a two-step flow: the institution POSTs this
manifest to receive a presigned URL (or batch_id with upload instructions),
then uploads the file out-of-band. Manifest fields are inspired by the
standards-pack table in market-comparators.md §5.A ("Batch manifest: file
name, reporting period, institution ID, schema version, row count, hash").

file_name.description: File name, ASCII safe characters only, with extension .csv, .jsonl, or .json.
file_name.title: File Name

reporting_period_end.description: Inclusive end of the reporting period covered by this batch.
reporting_period_end.title: Reporting Period End

reporting_period_start.description: Inclusive start of the reporting period covered by this batch.
reporting_period_start.title: Reporting Period Start

row_count.description: Number of complaint rows in the file.
row_count.title: Row Count

schema_version.description: Anexo 1-A schema version targeted by the batch. Matches the OpenAPI info.version on submission day. Example: v0.1.0.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the file contents the institution will upload. The server recomputes on receipt and rejects on mismatch.
sha256.title: Sha256

submitted_at.description: Institution-side timestamp of manifest preparation. Used only for audit log correlation; the authoritative receipt time is server-assigned.
submitted_at.title: Submitted At

title: BatchManifest
